description: This file implements a Data Encryption Unit driver for DES algorithm, including setup, core processing, queue management, and thread handling for asynchronous cryptographic operations on a Linux platform, specifically for the Lantiq hardware platform.

classes.name: des_ctx
classes.description: Structure holding DES context including control register mode, key length, IV, and expanded key.

classes.name: des_container
classes.description: Structure for managing DES operation buffers, IV, request, and processing state.

classes.name: lq_des_alg
classes.description: Structure representing a DES algorithm registration.

methods.name: lq_des_setkey
methods.description: Sets the DES key in the context.

methods.name: lq_des3_ede_setkey
methods.description: Sets the 3DES EDE key in the context.

methods.name: lq_deu_des_core
methods.description: Main interface to DES hardware for encryption/decryption.

methods.name: process_next_packet
methods.description: Processes the next data packet in the queue, handling scatterlist mapping and core operation.

methods.name: des_crypto_thread
methods.description: Thread function handling asynchronous DES requests and queue processing.

methods.name: lq_queue_mgr
methods.description: Manages queuing of DES requests, including scatterlist handling and core invocation.

methods.name: lq_des_encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts data using DES, queues request.

methods.name: lq_des_decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts data using DES, queues request.

methods.name: lqdeu_async_des_init
methods.description: Initializes the DES driver, registers algorithms.

methods.name: lqdeu_fini_async_des
methods.description: Unregisters the DES algorithms and cleans up.
